# F&O OData response fixtures

Prepared on 2026-10-09; live service-document/CSDL captures added on 2026-10-10 for [issue #504](https://github.com/PowerPlatformToolBox/desktop-app/issues/504). These files are offline regression inputs, not credentials or instructions to call a live environment.

| File | Provenance | Changes / limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| customers-page.json | Sanitized live-derived response supplied by the user on 2026-10-08 | Environment replaced with erp.example; company, account, group and currency replaced with test values; ETag omitted. Original selected fields and collection shape retained. |
| action-metadata.json | Extract from the user's parsed live metadata on 2026-10-08 | Only GetInstalledModules retained. This is the supplied parsed action descriptor, not a raw CSDL capture. |
| installed-modules.json | Sanitized, reduced live-derived HTTP/API response supplied by the user on 2026-10-08 | Two module entries retained, versions replaced with placeholders. Only Content-Type and OData-Version headers retained; dates, lengths, tenant URLs, tracing identifiers and server-specific headers omitted. |
| customer-account-validation.json | Sanitized live HTTP 400 response body captured on 2026-10-10 | Content-Type was application/json; odata.metadata=minimal. Retains actual error.code, error.message and innererror message/type/stacktrace fields. Invalid account and number-sequence format replaced with test values; stacktrace replaced with a redaction placeholder. Captured before conversion to FinanceOperationsError; temporary capture code and raw file removed afterward. |
| service-document.json | Sanitized, reduced live capture through the headless sample on 2026-10-10 | Successful getServiceDocument call with client-secret authentication. Retains CustomersV3 and SystemNotifications from 4,746 entries; context host replaced with erp.example; other entries and response headers omitted. |
| metadata.xml | Reduced live CSDL capture through the headless sample on 2026-10-10 | Successful getMetadata call returned 54,656,812 UTF-8 bytes. Retains actual CustomerV3 and SystemNotification keys, their key properties, selected customer properties, GetInstalledModules signature and two entity-set bindings. Unrelated schema and annotations removed; wrapper/container reduced to a Default container. Retained property attributes and action signature copied from live XML. This is a curated schema excerpt, not the complete CSDL. |
| customers-next-page.json | Sanitized live-derived following-page response supplied by the user on 2026-10-10 | Two distinct records retained; host, company and accounts replaced consistently with the first page; ETags omitted. Context projection and nextLink query preserved, advancing to $skip=4 with $top=2. This page also has a continuation; it is not a terminal-page capture. HTTP status and headers were not supplied. |
| customers-paged.json | Sanitized live-derived first-page response supplied by the user on 2026-10-10 | Two records retained; host, company and accounts replaced consistently; ETags omitted. Context projection and nextLink query preserved, including cross-company, encoded $select, $skip=2 and $top=2. Initial query, request page size, HTTP status and headers were not supplied. Following-page response captured in customers-next-page.json. |
| permission-denied.json | Sanitized live HTTP 403 response body captured on 2026-10-10 | Restricted-user CustomersV3 GET returned application/json; odata.metadata=minimal. Retains actual error.code, message and innererror message/type/stacktrace fields; server stacktrace replaced with a redaction placeholder. Captured before conversion to FinanceOperationsError; temporary capture code and raw file removed afterward. |

Both paging responses are live-derived. The permission-denial fixture now contains the captured live server envelope with its stack trace redacted. Live paging verification passed separately, as confirmed by the user on 2026-10-10; restricted entity denial passed on 2026-10-10; restricted Test Connection and List entity sets also passed, user confirmed on 2026-10-10. The validation error now uses the captured server envelope, with its stack trace redacted. Customer test values are deliberately fictional; no tokens, application IDs, real customer record keys, ETags or environment-specific tracing headers are stored. Live schema identifiers describe public types, properties and bindings; they are retained for contract verification.

The phase 1 fixture capture coverage is complete as of 2026-10-10. For future captures, replace identifiers/hosts consistently, remove credentials and identifying headers, retain message/envelope shapes, and record which fields were changed here. Update provenance only after a real capture is available. Full temporary captures are removed after fixture validation; only the sanitized fixtures belong in the repository.
